name: Antequera Dolmens Site
description: Near the city of Antequera in Andalusia, three prehistoric tombs lie buried under their original earth mounds: the Menga and Viera dolmens and the beehive-vaulted Tholos of El Romeral. Raised from huge stone blocks in the Neolithic and Bronze Age, they form roofed chambers you can walk into. The rock of La Peña de los Enamorados and the karst formations of El Torcal frame the site as natural landmarks.
